name: pi-pokepet
description: A cute, colorful Pokémon companion for the pi coding agent. Pick a Pokémon that lives below your editor and reacts to tools, tests, commits, PRs, reviews, subagents, model swaps and more — pure ASCII, works in any terminal. Unofficial fan project.
